description: This organisation's landing rules, ownership record and safety rules for scientific research, in one place: who asks and who the scientist is, what CI green means for a record that lands through a forge, what landed means for a protocol, a run, a result, a claim inside the group and a claim outside it (modes labelled on every claim, a check that isn't LLM judgement for every claim that leaves the group), the statistical sign-off setting, who does the work, the hosts agents run on and secrets, untrusted text, the sources agents may use, the instruments agents may drive through a gate (none by default), what must not leave, the irreversible steps (all the scientist's), publishing, study records private by default, the findings worth keeping, who owns which areas, and where the study records are kept. Composed by every soul (the dispatcher, the study leads, the analysts, the study reviewers and the record stewards), so every role's safety rules have one home. Adapted from the research template's landing rules, template-v1.0.1, with the engineering template's CI-green definition and host rules, template-v2.2.0. The template's rules are an example to adapt. Copied from the scientific research template, template-v2.1.1.
